records.source: The top of the ring is made from enchanted purple wool.
records.translation: Gawa sa engkantadong lilang lana ang ibabaw ng singsing.

records.source: Glows, attracts items, and increases attack damage by 10%.
records.translation: Kumikinang, umaakit ng mga bagay, at pinatataas nang 10% ang pinsala ng pag-atake.
Makapangyarihang 'gatas' na hindi alam ang pinagmulan...

records.source: An exotic ore with many curious properties. Can be smelted into bars.
records.translation: Kakaibang mineral na maraming kataka-takang katangian. Maaaring tunawin upang maging mga lingote.

records.source: Waters the 24 adjacent tiles every morning.
records.translation: Dinidiligan ang 24 na katabing parisukat tuwing umaga.

records.source: Break apart to obtain iridium ore.
records.translation: Basagin upang makakuha ng Mineral na Iridyum.

records.source: Lasts longer than a stone fence.
records.translation: Mas matagal itong masira kaysa sa bakod na bato.

records.source: A fairly common ore that can be smelted into bars.
records.translation: Medyo karaniwang mineral na maaaring tunawin upang maging mga lingote.

records.source: Break apart to obtain iron ore.
records.translation: Basagin upang makakuha ng Mineral na Bakal.

records.preserveReason: Jagoite is the proper name of this fictional mineral.

records.source: A high volume of tiny crystals makes it very glittery.
records.translation: Labis itong kumikislap dahil sa napakaraming maliliit na kristal.

records.preserveReason: Jamborite is the proper name of this fictional mineral.

records.source: The crystals are so tightly packed it almost looks fuzzy.
records.translation: Napakasiksik ng mga kristal kaya halos magmukhang mabalahibo.

records.source: When polished, this stone becomes attractively luminous. Prized by ancient peoples for thousands of years.
records.translation: Kapag pinakintab, nagiging kaakit-akit ang liwanag ng batong ito. Libo-libong taon na itong pinahahalagahan ng mga sinaunang tao.

records.englishResidueReason: Jazz is retained as the fictional Blue Jazz flower's proper variety name.

records.source: Plant in spring. Takes 7 days to produce a blue puffball flower.
records.translation: Itanim sa tagsibol. Tumatagal ng 7 araw upang magpatubo ng bughaw at bilog na bulaklak.
